responsibility: This definition module declares an argv/argc manipulation abstraction for GNU Modula-2 option-processing code. It introduces an opaque Option type and exports constructors, shallow duplication and slicing of argument vectors, string-based index search helpers, concatenation, and accessors for argc and argv, forming a utility layer for rearranging command-line argument lists rather than parsing options itself.
same_name_distinction: This .def file is the public interface for the OptLib pair: it only declares the opaque Option type and the argv/argc manipulation procedures, while the same-stem implementation file OptLib.mod defines the concrete record layout, freelist allocation, and shallow-copy mechanics behind those operations.
